title: SeedWater / native Moxi
scenario: Actual AppKit content-view cacheDisplay captures of a running Moxi native consumer. Scripted native callbacks; offscreen render, excludes compositor/window chrome/physical input. VoiceOver paused.
backend: Moxi AppKit / copied RGBA8 / nearest sampling / public Camera
fixture: Synthetic TYX 3 × 93 × 157; uint16; pinned upstream 45bd4bf / NumPy 1.22.0 / mahotas 1.4.11; exact stable IDs
reproduce: See README.md: run moxi-sws/scripts/evidence.py with explicit MOXI_ROOT, MOJO, MODULAR_HOME, SWS_REFERENCE, SWS_LEGACY_PYTHON

slides.caption: Pinned asymmetric stack / stable cell 7
slides.action: Open synthetic fixture in native Moxi window
slides.expected: TYX origin, unequal image dimensions, sparse stable IDs and cell boundary agree

slides.action: Native frame / contrast / zoom controls; public Camera pan
slides.expected: Frame 2, 3.2× zoom; image and labels stay aligned; no image upload on pan

slides.caption: Native resize retains document and ownership

slides.expected: Remaining window, camera, image and scientific data stay valid

slides.expected: Application document survives; retired resource cannot be reused
